name: Tespe (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tespe (a white pile with a half-timbered house over green and a wavy bar).
history: Municipal flag of Tespe; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Tespe arms — pile with house and wavy bar
